name: malka-claude-mods
description: A personal collection of Claude Code mods; install whichever you like.

plugins.name: sentinel
plugins.description: A live band above the prompt showing running subagents and background Bash, at zero token cost.

plugins.name: resume
plugins.description: Detects a previous session that was interrupted mid-turn and offers Resume/Dismiss in a band above the prompt.

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: A status line under the prompt: model, folder and branch, context, 5h/7d limits and cache. Off by default; /statusline on turns it on.

plugins.name: cleanscreen
plugins.description: Hides tool calls and their output, shows Claude's text and a progress band above the prompt. Off by default; /cleanscreen on turns it on.

plugins.name: mode
plugins.description: Pick the model and the reasoning effort from one small pane or /mode. Does nothing until you pick something.

plugins.name: permissions
plugins.description: Shows the permission mode and picks the one new sessions start in (permissions.defaultMode). Does nothing until you pick something.

plugins.name: menu
plugins.description: An optional /mods menu that lists the installed mods (status line, clean screen, mode) and opens each one's page in a pane.
